note: Day 1 morning lines. Written by Content Writer. Keys under 'steps' match the setStep ids in src/world/morning.js so Game Dev can look lines up by id. 'bubble' is a speech bubble (who says it), 'caption' is a narration line, 'move' is the on-screen motion cue. No balance numbers live here: effects stay in the game code and activities.csv. The roommate is whichever of the eight in roommates.json the player picked, the bestie the player meets in person.

goal.text: Get to your 9:00 lecture on time.
goal.hint: Eat something, head out, make it to your lecture.
goal.met: You made it. 9:00 and you are already winning.
goal.failed: Late. The lecturer notices. So does everyone else.

roommate.name: {roommate}
roommate.role: Your roommate in the house. Your bestie from day one.
roommate.look: Oversized hoodie, one earbud in, hair wrapped for the night and not quite unwrapped.
roommate.intro: That is {roommate}. She will borrow things all year and return them with interest.
roommate.wave: Morning, roomie! I’m {roommate} 👋 Alarm’s about to go.
roommate.wave_day2: Morning, roomie! First real morning in res 👋 Sleep okay?

wake.caption: {house}, 07:00. Your phone buzzes on the pillow. Your stomach buzzes louder.
wake.bubble_day2: 07:00. Alarm. Day two in res… snooze.

roommate.text: Mm. You snoozed {n} times. I counted. We are going to be friends.

wake.move: Blanket slides off, stripe of sun crosses the floor, {roommate} rolls over in the other bed.
wake.question: Alarm! Get up or snooze?

kettle.caption: Four steps to the kettle. It is a small room and a long walk.

kettle-walk.caption: Slippers squeak across the tiles. Somebody else is already heading to the kettle.

roommate_walks_over.text: Wait, I was first. I can smell it.

noodles.caption: Masala flavour. The kettle clicks, steam curls up, and the day is going well.

roommate.text: Save me the flavour sachet. I will pay you in gossip.

roommate.caption: The cupboard is empty. {roommate} is standing there with the wrapper and a very guilty smile.

bubble.text: Sorry! Last packet 😅 I’ll buy more later.

roommate.introduction: Hi, I'm {roommate}. Your roommate. Let's do this properly.
roommate.move: {roommate} steps in with the wrapper, crinkles it, gives you the biggest sorry eyes.
roommate.bare: The shelf is bare. Your roommate got the last packet.

caf_later.bubble: Caf pap on campus. Hold on, stomach.

caf-later.caption: Breakfast can wait for the caf on campus. Your stomach disagrees.

caf-breakfast.caption: Out the door and straight into the caf queue. Pap and egg, R30.

tuckshop.caption: Down the corridor, past three people in towels. The tuck shop auntie is smiling.

bubble.text: Noodles? Last one, my girl. Hurry, the bell is coming.

roommate_after.text: I will pay you back on NSFAS day. Pinky promise.

skip.caption: Your stomach files a complaint and copies in your wallet.

roommate.text: Take this biscuit. Do not tell anyone I am a nice person.

door.prompt: 🚪 Head out to the bus stop
door.caption: Bag, student card, charger. In that order, because panic has an order.

exit.caption: Door, stairwell, sunshine. The whole house smells of toast and ambition.

roommate_at_door.text: Go go go! Save me a seat at the back if we have the same class.

to-stop.caption: Past the res gate and the vendors setting up. Someone says "Morning, love" and means it.

walk-stop.caption: Flip-flops, vendors, a dog trotting across the road like it has a lecture too.

stop.caption: A small queue. Everyone checks their phone and pretends not to look at the road.

bus-arriving.caption: Here it comes, wheezing like it has done this a thousand times. It has.

board.caption: Doors fold open. The queue surges. You surge with it.

boarding.caption: Window seat, bag on your knees. A speaker three rows back is playing amapiano.

riding.caption: Campus slides past the glass. A student dozes with their head on the window.

arrive.caption: The gate, the Quad, the crowd streaming toward the lecture venues.

on_time.title: You made it to campus
on_time.line: {min} minutes to find your venue and a seat.

late.title: You made it… just
late.line: You slip in after it started. −2 Grades.

hungry.bubble: No breakfast, no problem. Probably. Bus, here I come.

head-out.caption: Bag, student card, charger. Walk to the stop, or let the morning blur by.

meet.caption: Same bus, same wait. They have nice shoes and a very judgemental eyebrow for the timetable.

skip-ride.caption: Shower, the stop, the bus, the gate. UMzansi appears like a jump cut.

out-door.caption: Out of your own front door. Campus is right here: no bus, no queue at the stop.

bus_late.caption: The bus coughs, stops at a red robot, and sits there. You watch 08:45 go by.

bubble.text: Come on, come on, come ON.

roommate_text.text: Where are you? Lecturer already looks angry.

snoozed_too_long.caption: You snoozed one too many. The kettle never even gets a chance.

roommate.text: I let you sleep. I regret it. Run.

missed_bus.caption: The bus pulls away as you round the corner. You wave. It does not wave back.

tap_feedback: Footsteps trail behind you for a second.
Your bag bounces against your back.
A taxi hoots like it has an opinion.

men.name: {roommate}
men.role: Your roommate in the house, for a male student. Your bestie from day one.
men.look: Blue varsity jacket over a vest, one sock on, phone already at 12%.
men.intro: That is {roommate}. He has a plan for everything except mornings.
men.note: A male roommate (Ethan, Marcus, Ryan, Ravi) has his own lines. Keys mirror the ones they replace (path in the morning code -> line). {roommate} is the roommate's name.

lines.roommate.wave: Ayy, roomie! I’m {roommate} 👊 Your alarm is about to scream.
lines.roommate.wave_day2: Ayy, roomie! First real morning in res 👊 Sleep okay, bra?
lines.steps.wake.roommate: Snoozed {n} times, bra. I was keeping score.
lines.late_variants.snoozed_too_long.roommate: I tried, my guy. You fought the alarm and lost. Go!
lines.steps.roommate.bubble: Eish, sorry! Last packet 😅 I’ll sort you out at lunch.
lines.steps.roommate.bare: The shelf is empty. {roommate} is holding the last packet like a trophy.
